span.p: status: ACTIVE/DISABLED/FROZEN/DEACTIVATED/ARCHIVED\n归档为终态，非正常状态拒绝创建业务数据\ntenantCode 全局唯一 = TenantContext tenantId

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
聚合边界: UserEntity/UserProfile/UserRole/UserConsent
status: 0=禁用 1=正常
openId 微信身份, unionId 跨应用
username 全局唯一(uk_username)

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p: dataScope: ALL/DEPT_AND_SUB/DEPT/SELF/CUSTOM\ncode 大写下划线: ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p: code 格式: {资源}:{操作} 如 user:read\nresourceType: MENU/BUTTON/API

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p: 树形结构 parentId=0 为根\nancestors 逗号分隔如 0,100\n支撑 @DataScope 部门级数据权限

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p: menuType: 0=目录 1=菜单 2=按钮\n按钮类型必须携带 perms\nparentId=0 为顶级菜单

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p: configType: 0=系统内置(BUILTIN) 1=自定义(USER)\n支持热更新

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p: misfirePolicy: 立即执行/放弃/下次执行\nconcurrent: 允许/禁止\ncronExpression Quartz 格式

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p: @OperationLog AOP 切面记录\ntraceId 全链路追踪\n异步批量落库
